role: Test plan referenced by the Emuqu scheme: runs EmuquTests in parallel and EmuquUITests serially, in random order, with coverage on the Emuqu target.
toplevel: configurations: one 'Default' with codeCoverage targets [Emuqu]. defaultOptions.testExecutionOrdering = random (applies to both targets). testTargets: EmuquTests parallelizable true; EmuquUITests parallelizable false. Two _comment strings record why: UI tests flaked under parallel simulator clones (SettingsNavigationUITests, 2026-08-19), and random ordering became safe for UI tests once AppLaunchRecovery.removeStoredSessionData() wiped archive/raw-RR directories under -UITests-FreshInstall (verified: Emuqu/Sources/Services/AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185-193,217; all 18 UI test files reference -UITests-FreshInstall). Random ordering makes order-dependent unit tests fail non-deterministically rather than consistently.

flags.text: The plan marks EmuquTests parallelizable and EmuquUITests not, but scripts/run_tests_with_coverage.sh (the CI test path, ci.yml:493) passes -parallel-testing-enabled NO by default, overriding both, and its comment at line 64 says 'Both test targets are marked parallelizable', contradicting the plan. The plan's parallel settings take effect only for `make test`/Xcode runs.
